note: In 'as a first pass put the Rent layer at the bottom of the stack' the circuit writes the command 'put' as a declarative clause and gives it the subject 'a first pass', which the words do not show.

In 'value axis still log on the negative stretch' the words have no verb, but the circuit makes 'log', which only says how the axis should be, the verb of a declarative clause with 'value axis' as its subject.

In 'do the value axis still log on the negative stretch on the profit chart' the first word 'do' is the verb of a command, but the circuit writes it as the auxiliary of an interrogative clause and makes 'log' its verb.
In 'so for their sake make the flow lines denser' the circuit ties the command 'make' inside the declarative clause by a relation marked 'so', but a command cannot stand inside another clause.
In 'so as a first pass make the callout arrows curved' the circuit ties the command 'make' inside the clause of 'argued' by a relation marked 'so', but a command cannot stand inside another clause.
